mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_tag (id, name, description, color, type, is_system, organization_id, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time) VALUES (#{tag.id}, #{tag.name}, #{tag.description}, #{tag.color}, #{tag.type}, #{tag.isSystem}, #{tag.organizationId}, #{tag.createdBy}, #{tag.createdTime}, #{tag.updatedBy}, #{tag.updatedTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_tag SET name = #{tag.name}, description = #{tag.description}, color = #{tag.color}, type = #{tag.type}, updated_by = #{tag.updatedBy}, updated_time = #{tag.updatedTime} WHERE id = #{tag.id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, color, type, is_system as isSystem, organization_id as organizationId, created_by as createdBy, created_time as createdTime, updated_by as updatedBy, updated_time as updatedTime FROM customer_tag WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, description, color, type, is_system as isSystem, organization_id as organizationId, created_by as createdBy, created_time as createdTime, updated_by as updatedBy, updated_time as updatedTime FROM customer_tag WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT id as value, name as label FROM customer_tag WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY created_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_tag_relation (id, customer_id, tag_id, organization_id, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time) VALUES (#{relation.id}, #{relation.customerId}, #{relation.tagId}, #{relation.organizationId}, #{relation.createdBy}, #{relation.createdTime}, #{relation.updatedBy}, #{relation.updatedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.description, t.color, t.type, t.is_system as isSystem, t.organization_id as organizationId, t.created_by as createdBy, t.created_time as createdTime, t.updated_by as updatedBy, t.updated_time as updatedTime FROM customer_tag t INNER JOIN customer_tag_relation r ON t.id = r.tag_id WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_tag_relation WHERE tag_id = #{tagId}
